query:
The group operates on the understanding that when someone cannot make a plan, they give as much notice as possible. Does this hold for everyone in the group? If not, who behaves differently and what in the conversation shows it?

Options:
A. Jonah
B. Priya
C. Dev
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Marcus, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:31:00) You're welcome to join us, Jonah. Dev and I are doing a twelve-kilometre trail route on the 30th. No Priya, obviously. She's been formally excused on medical grounds.
[2] (about=Priya, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T19:01:00) so the plan is Priya stands at the bottom in enormous waterproofs while Dev and Marcus sprint past her like it's a race 😑 amazing. Simone you're the only reasonable person coming on this trip
[3] (about=Jonah, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:30:00) Dev and Marcus are now a trail running duo and no one told me. I am genuinely hurt. I have been evangelising this group for countryside stuff for YEARS and Dev just quietly became the athlete
[4] (about=Jonah, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T19:03:00) ok this is actually perfect, Dev and Marcus doing the fast bit up front, me and Jonah in the middle being correct about hiking, Priya and Simone forming an orderly rear guard. we will all meet at the pub and it will be beautiful
[5] (about=Jonah, episodic, t2 @2025-10-12T18:02:00) the seating plan thing is real. Marcus assigned seats at his own birthday dinner. by preference and conversation compatibility. i am not joking
[6] (about=Marcus, core, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) Needs to make a New Year booking by Friday at the latest and asks everyone to confirm their plans.
[7] (about=Simone, core, t10 @2025-11-09T19:31:00) Knew about the Singapore secondment for three weeks; told Priya the same day she signed but wanted to get the notice sorted before telling the group.
agent_answer:
No — it does not hold for everyone. **Simone** behaves differently: she knew about the Singapore secondment for three weeks and, although she told Priya the same day she signed, she wanted to get the notice sorted before telling the group, thereby delaying giving the group as much notice as possible.

*(Simone is not among the listed options A–D.)*
